$description: Mökin vedet v2 — the Hana design system. The single source of truth for every design token. Edit this file, then run `python3 v2/design-system/build-tokens.py` to regenerate v2/themes/tokens.css. Each leaf key is the CSS custom property name without the leading `--`; the groups only organise. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) — `$value`, `$type`, `$description`, and `{group.key}` for an alias.

ground.$description: The page itself; cards float on this.

card.$description: Task cards, tool box, modal, home cards.

done-bg.$description: A completed step recedes into a tint.

locked-bg.$description: So does a step you have not reached.

ink.$description: Structure: every border, every drop shadow, the progress fill, the bar across a photo.

text.$description: What you read. Follows ink; give it its own hex to pull them apart.

muted.$description: The locked step's title and number.

locked-line.$description: The dashed border around a locked card. The only outline that card has, so it must stay above 3:1.

lock.$description: The padlock. Filled, so lighter than muted to keep the weight down. #6d8a52 is the lightest that clears 3:1 on the locked card.

accent.$description: A FILL that always carries dark text on top, so bright is the safe direction.

accent-ink.$description: Darker sibling for small uppercase labels, which need more contrast than a fill. Does not follow accent; check both if you retint.

overlay.$description: Behind the lightbox and the completion modal.

font-body.$description: Everything you read, and the uppercase labels.

type.$description: Finding 4: v1 was 15–16px and testers wanted bigger. Line-heights are unitless in the components so they scale.

heading-size.$description: Phase heading, app bar title, modal text.

title-size.$description: Task card titles, home card titles.

label-size.$description: VAIHE 1, OHJEET, TYÖKALUT, the Huomio tab.

radius-sm.$description: Badges, thumbnails, counters, the progress track.

border.$description: Every border, everywhere. Also the focus ring's width and gap.

shadow-offset.$description: Hard ink shadow, x and y. Buttons press into it on :active.

space.$description: 8px grid. 4px only between a label and its text, and for pill insets.

space-64.$description: Scroll padding under the sticky progress bar.
